name: RoamSEO
description: Hosted SEO data for AI agents. Look up keyword volume and difficulty, read live Google results, check a domain's backlinks and ranked keywords, run site audits and rank trackers, and see how often a brand appears in AI answers. Search Console and Google Analytics reads for connected accounts are free; fresh search data is billed per call in credits (plans from $10 a month, or credit packs). Sign in with OAuth in the browser.
author: RoamSEO
